notes.title: Version 1.2.0.1 released, Undo/Redo functions added
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
This is a minor version update that adds undo and redo function to PieceEditor. The experience of this feature may not be as satisfying at this stage, but will be modified as the user feedback. The related functions of other editors will be updated in the next period of time, please be patient ːsteamhappyː

[b]Update content[/b]
[list]
[*]Add undo and redo functions to PieceEditor, corresponding to the common shortcut keys Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y
[*]Stability update, fix crash in some cases
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0.2 is released, new characters are coming!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

After a long period of training, the two new built-in characters finally came to everyone! Although there are not many resources at present, everyone can also use their imagination to freely tune and release the characters from our resouces. Thank you for your long-awaited expectations.

Another good news is that because the current version is quite complete, we will be making video tutorials based on the current version.

In the next version, we will gradually add the undo function and create a new animation editing system to replace the current lua scripting system, so that you can create an interactive animation without writing any code, and we will consider to add the physics engine's ability to animation system in the future. If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us!

The following is update details
[i]Features[/i]
[list]
[*]Added rotation function! Can rotate the Piece and animation node as a whole
[*]Moving function can move the entire animation node
[*]All editors added the zoom scroll bar for easy zooming
[*]Optimize the AnimEditor interface experience, parameter tab and animation node tab split into separate sub-windows
[*]IdolEditor will display the wireframe of the FFD editor by default
[*]After adding an animation node in IdolEditor, the newly added item will be automatically selected.
[*]Updated the content of the new interface in the manual
[/list]

[i]Issues[/i]
[list]
[*]Fix the problem that the parameter panel alpha value is incorrect in some cases in IdolEditor
[*]Fix some bugs in editing alpha animation in IdolEditor
[*]Fixed the bug in PieceEditor that deletes Piece without deleting the data in the animation node it is in.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0.1 is released, some of the main features are coming!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, after a long period of time, this major version of DimensionTwo has finally been completed and released. In this version, we migrated the underlying layer from DX9 to DX11, providing capabilities and performance support for the new animation framework, and adding the FFD modifier. Now it's easy to modify the shape of the model. The details is as follows:


[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*]Migrating from DX9 to DX11
[*]Support FFD modifier function, the name is called deformer in the program
[*]Optimized interface operation of IdolEditor
[*]Remove texture preprocessing steps, textures can be used directly
[*]Updated the contents of the Chinese and English sections of the manual
[/list]

[b]Issues fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]Idol disappears or shows in error coordinate in some cases
[*]Fixed the wire frame remaining when deleting vertices in PieceEditor in some cases
[*]PieceEditor "Show raw texture" button state is not correct
[*]Addition and deletion of Piece operations in IdolEditor may cause problems with animation state remaining
[*]Resetting animation in IdolEditor may cause problems with animation state remaining
[*] Various details corrections
[/list]

[b]Next version plans[/b]
We'll add some new built-in characters, then further optimize the modifier, and also add official video tutorials, so stay tuned!

[/i]Remarks: Due to the large modification of DX9 migration to DX11, there may be some problems that we have not been able to test. If you encounter any problems, please contact us, thank you[/i]

notes.title: 1.0.0.7 Update
notes.notes:
We have focused on revising and optimizing the user feedback and issues we have collected recently, including
This version has fixed issues from user feedback and ourself, and improved overall performance, including
[list]
[*]Support multiple screens, you can drag between screens, but for performance reasons, cross-screen display is not supported at this time.
[*]Support high DPI settings to optimize display quality on high resolution screens
[*]Performance optimization, reducing the CPU consumption of animation and improving performance on low-end PCs
[/list]

Subsequent focus will be on the editor and new built-in characters, thanks to the support of the players!

notes.title: Workshop was released！ And future version plans
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! DimensionTwo's Workshop has been launched. You can upload your own creations at will. The simple instructions for the Workshop are also updated in the user manual. Please check it in the program~

The new version also fixed some issues, including
Fixed bugs lossing character coordinates and scaling values in some cases, which appears to fill half of the screen after startup.
Optimize editor save logic

Regarding the new version, it is already under development, and our plan will include the following main features.
For Idol Editor, adds a new modifier for easier adjustment of large movements
Add more built-in waifus
Fix the problem that cannot be used under multiple monitors at present

Since the new version involves more content, tt may be split into multiple releases. It may be released in April. Please wait patiently. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us or leave a message in the discussion area, we will answer in time!

Thank you!
